hero.description: I'm a software engineer who develops modern web applications. I work with technologies like React, Node.js, and Python.

ecommerce-admin.title: E-commerce Admin Dashboard
ecommerce-admin.description: An admin dashboard for managing an e-commerce platform. It provides features for product management, order tracking, and user analytics. Built with React and Next.js. Integrated with a RESTful API.

ecommerce-storefront.title: E-commerce Storefront
ecommerce-storefront.description: A full-featured e-commerce storefront built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB. It includes product listings, shopping cart functionality, and payment processing using Stripe.
